body.statement: When \(J=1\), \(A_{\mathrm{PT}}=0\), so profiling the sole treated-versus-donor equality leaves no PT observed-data normal and the PT observed-law tangent space is unrestricted. At every intersection law the full-rank SC observed model is therefore locally nested in the PT observed model, \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm{PT}}(P_0)\subseteq\mathcal I_{\mathrm{SC}}(P_0)\), \(\phi_U=\phi_{\mathrm{PT}}\), and \(V_U=V_{\mathrm{PT}}\). With \(T=2\), this PT gradient equals the panel-DiD ATT efficient influence function in SantAnnaZhao2020, Proposition 1.
body.justification: This reduction checks that the new envelope collapses to the established two-group panel-DiD bound when union geometry disappears.
body.gap: SantAnnaZhao2020 gives the two-group panel-DiD bound but does not derive it as the nested special case of a PT-or-SC union envelope.
body.consumer: The reduction provides a benchmark against the maintained two-period DiD routines already used by empirical researchers.
